headline: Arizona State seeks upset bid against stumbling Ohio State squad
subhead: Both teams arrive wounded, but the Buckeyes' ranking carries expectations.

xFactor.why: Arizona State's pass rush must create chaos early to disrupt Ohio State's rhythm and prevent the Buckeyes from settling into a rhythm.

keyMatchup: Arizona State's secondary coverage depth against Ohio State's receiver separation at the intermediate level will determine field position and red-zone efficiency.
body: Both programs enter Week 10 reeling from decisive road losses that exposed fundamental breakdowns. Arizona State's 9-27 defeat to Michigan State revealed offensive line vulnerabilities and conservative play-calling, while Ohio State's 21-38 collapse at Notre Dame showed a defense unable to adjust to personnel adjustments and an offense too reliant on explosive plays.

The Buckeyes' higher ranking reflects talent and trajectory, but they're vulnerable enough that Arizona State's desperate push for bowl eligibility carries real bite. Look for Arizona State to attack Ohio State's secondary early and often—the Buckeyes showed susceptibility to vertical passing last week, and a turnover or two could flip this contest entirely.
